top_choice_rationale: P003 is a prediction-then-observation chain (Kane-Mele Z2 classification and quantum spin Hall effect, Molenkamp's HgTe edge transport) with about fifteen years of independent confirmation and a stable interpretation. The three names follow the originating joint theory and the first observation, and a narrow citation avoids claiming all topological insulator physics. The omission of Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang and Hasan is a real cost that the citation can only disclose; P001 has cleaner attribution but is eight years old with an unresolved pairing mechanism, so I rank it second, ahead of the clean but incremental-looking P002 and the P004 case that overlaps the 2012 prize.
